about.body: The M54 is BMW's naturally aspirated inline-six petrol engine, produced from 2000 to 2006. It was fitted to the first-generation Z4 (E85/E86) across three capacity variants — 2.2L, 2.5L and 3.0L. The M54 was one of BMW's most widely-used six-cylinder engines of its era, also appearing in the E46 3 Series, E39 5 Series and E53 X5, though our work here covers the Z4 application specifically.

byModel.body: Across the Z4, the M54 powered the 2.2i, 2.5i and 3.0i variants throughout the first-generation E85 roadster and E86 coupé production run, from 2002 through to 2006. This is the only BMW application we cover for the M54.

compatibility.body: Because the M54 was offered in three different capacities (2.2L, 2.5L and 3.0L) and across multiple BMW models of the era, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model and variant. A Z4 M54 isn't automatically a drop-in match for an M54 from another BMW — ancillaries, mounting and ECU calibration all differ across applications. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
